services._note: Heading above the Face / Body / Wellness tiles on /treatments/. Put *asterisks* around words to show them in italic rose. Each tile's treatment count, starting price and peek list come from the treatments below automatically.
services.heading: Explore our *services*
services.lede: Three ways to feel like you, each one personalised by our therapists.

trending._note: New & trending banners on /treatments/ (below the Face/Body/Wellness tiles). One wide banner on top (1920 x 480) and two half-width banners under it (960 x 480 each), in that order. image = a file path in public/images/banners/, or "" for a placeholder. Any words should be part of the image itself. alt = what the banner says or shows, for screen readers. link = where it goes when clicked, e.g. "/rituals/?area=face" (or "" for no link). Write the heading with *asterisks* around the words to show in italic rose. No before-and-after images or guaranteed results.
trending.heading: This season's *spotlight*
trending.lede: New arrivals and the rituals our guests keep coming back for. Tap one to take a closer look.

treatments.name: MC Signature Face Therapy
treatments.for: For skin that feels dry, tight or tired
treatments.description: Our house facial: deep cellular hydration that drenches thirsty skin and lifts a tired complexion, leaving it soft, plump and refreshed.

treatments.name: JUVE Face Lift Therapy
treatments.for: For skin that looks less firm, and facial contour concerns
treatments.description: A sculpting ritual designed to firm and define, so the jawline and cheekbones look lifted and the skin feels taut and renewed.

treatments.name: CLARIO Porcelain Skin Therapy
treatments.for: For sensitive, redness-prone and acne-prone skin
treatments.description: Gentle microneedling infusion that helps calm visible redness, refine pores and support the skin barrier for a smooth, porcelain finish. No downtime.

treatments.name: Venus Freeze Face Toning
treatments.for: For a firmer, more toned-looking facial contour
treatments.description: Soothing, comfortable warmth works across the face, designed to tone and tighten. Pick a quick lunchtime refresh or a longer sculpting session.

treatments.name: Lemongrass Lymphatic Drainage
treatments.description: A zesty lemongrass scrub and flowing drainage strokes that awaken sleepy cells and leave you feeling light, lifted and refreshed.

treatments.name: LPG Cellu M6 Alliance
treatments.description: Rhythmic mechanical massage that smooths the look of cellulite and helps skin feel firmer. Target one area or treat several in a longer session.

treatments.name: Venus Freeze Body Toning
treatments.for: For tone and definition on arms, tummy and thighs
treatments.description: Comfortable, deep warmth glides over the body, designed to tone and tighten so skin looks smoother and more defined. Choose the time that suits your areas.

treatments.name: Breast Lymph Node Drainage Therapy
treatments.for: For a fuller look using natural wellness techniques
treatments.description: A gentle technique working across the lymph nodes around the bust to encourage drainage and circulation, leaving you lighter and cared for.

treatments.name: Five Elements Signature Wellness
treatments.for: For everyday aches, stiffness and tension
treatments.description: A warming ritual of our 15-ingredient fermented vinegar blend, moxibustion, cupping and gua sha that helps ease stiffness and leaves skin soft and nourished.

treatments.name: 360 Experience
treatments.for: A full unwind, head to toe
treatments.description: Your own curated journey: a face therapy, face add-on, eye care and a body wellness therapy, all chosen for you in one long, unhurried visit.

treatments.name: Intensive Electro Lymphatic Detox
treatments.for: For heaviness, puffiness and a sluggish feeling
treatments.description: Gentle electro-stimulation designed to encourage lymphatic flow and ease that heavy, puffy feeling, so you leave feeling lighter and re-energised.

treatments.name: Mud Therapy with Thermal Blanket
treatments.for: A comforting add-on for any body ritual
treatments.description: Warm mud cocooned beneath a thermal blanket. Fifteen quiet minutes of deep, enveloping heat to soothe the body and settle the mind.

filters._note: Rituals page (/rituals/) filter sidebar. concerns = every concern a visitor can tick, in the order they are listed (an area shows its first 6, the rest behind '+ N more'). A concern only appears under an area that has at least one treatment with it. concernsOnAll = the 6 shown when Area is 'All'. Each treatment lists its concern ids under "concerns". budgets and durations are the pill buttons; a treatment matches when one of its sessions fits every chosen pill (and is a First Trial session when that switch is on). Collections come from each treatment's tag (e.g. Signature, New) plus any names in its optional "collections" list.
